visual_goal: Show Axleby's critical journeys and the external systems under them: only the build-data miss and the register transaction are synchronous; the others are mirrored, queued or acknowledged asynchronously.
prompt: A left-to-right map illustration. Left column: four rounded journey cards stacked top to bottom, labeled 'Lookup and appraisal', 'Registration at delivery', 'Publish and withdraw' and 'Lead delivery'. Right column: five generic external system boxes behind a thin vertical boundary line, labeled 'Register information channel', 'Build data provider', 'Register transaction channel', '61 portal channels' and 'DMS'. Exactly five arrows from left to right. From 'Lookup and appraisal' a dashed teal arrow to 'Register information channel', labeled 'async mirror'. From 'Lookup and appraisal' a solid orange arrow to 'Build data provider', labeled 'sync on cache miss'. From 'Registration at delivery' a solid orange arrow to 'Register transaction channel', labeled 'sync with legal effect'. From 'Publish and withdraw' a dashed teal arrow to '61 portal channels', labeled 'async per channel'. From 'Lead delivery' a dashed teal arrow to 'DMS', labeled 'async with receipt'. These fourteen quoted labels are the only words in the image.
alt: Four journeys on the left connect to five external systems on the right; two orange solid arrows mark synchronous calls (build data on cache miss, register transaction), three teal dashed arrows mark asynchronous ones.

visual_goal: Show one health state driving the queue and the dealer's screen: the monitor stops submissions when the channel is slow, tells dealers, then the queue sends trial submissions and drains at a paced rate.
prompt: A left-to-right swimlane illustration with four vertical lanes, each headed by an icon and a label: a gauge box labeled 'Session monitor', a stacked-envelope queue labeled 'Trade retry queue', a generic dealer screen labeled 'Lotwise', and a plain government-style building box labeled 'Register transaction channel'. Horizontal arrows top to bottom: one arrow from 'Session monitor' to 'Register transaction channel' labeled 'measure latency'; one orange arrow from 'Session monitor' to 'Trade retry queue' labeled 'stop new submissions'; one arrow from 'Session monitor' to 'Lotwise' labeled 'registrations queued'; one green arrow from 'Trade retry queue' to 'Register transaction channel' labeled 'trial submissions'; one dashed return arrow from 'Register transaction channel' to 'Trade retry queue' labeled 'confirmations'; one green arrow from 'Trade retry queue' to 'Register transaction channel' labeled 'paced drain'. These ten quoted labels are the only words in the image.
alt: Swimlanes for session monitor, trade retry queue, Lotwise and the register channel: the monitor measures latency, stops submissions and tells dealers registrations are queued; the queue then sends trial submissions, receives confirmations and drains at a paced rate.

visual_goal: Show the shared dependency health states: healthy, slow, down, planned maintenance and recovering, with the transitions between them.
prompt: A simple state map of five rounded tiles on a light background. Top left: green 'Healthy'. Top right: orange 'Slow'. Bottom right: red 'Down'. Bottom left: grey-blue 'Planned maintenance'. Center bottom between them: teal 'Recovering'. Exactly eight arrows: one from 'Healthy' to 'Slow' labeled 'latency or errors'; one from 'Slow' back to 'Healthy'; one from 'Slow' down to 'Down' labeled 'consecutive failures'; one from 'Healthy' down to 'Planned maintenance' labeled 'calendar window'; one from 'Planned maintenance' to 'Recovering'; one from 'Down' to 'Recovering' labeled 'probe succeeds'; one from 'Recovering' back to 'Down' labeled 'trial fails'; one from 'Recovering' up to 'Healthy' labeled 'queue drained'. A small gauge icon inside 'Slow'. These eleven quoted labels are the only words in the image.
alt: Five health states: Healthy moves to Slow on latency or errors and back; Slow moves to Down after consecutive failures; Healthy moves to Planned maintenance when a calendar window opens; Planned maintenance and Down move to Recovering; Recovering returns to Down if the trial fails or to Healthy when the queue is drained.
